title: TeamFinance — migrate() sqrtPriceX96 Parameter Manipulation Attack Analysis
loss_raw: ~$15.8M (multiple tokens: USDC, DAI, CAW, TSUKA, etc.)
root_cause: The `migrate()` function does not validate the `sqrtPriceX96` parameter, allowing an arbitrary price range to be set when creating a Uniswap V3 position
steps: Burn V2 LP → receive token0, token1
Mint V3 position → deposit large amount of one token only
→ remaining token returned to attacker as "residual"
